data.text:
LOOK: The parish church and plaza of Zarraga town in Iloilo province was checked and cleared following a bomb threat on Thursday, November 20.

The area was checked by the EOD and K9 units of the Iloilo Provincial Police Office (IPPO), Zarraga Municipal Police Station, Zarraga Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP), and the MDRRMO. 

Zarraga is the latest in the spate of bomb threats in the city and province of Iloilo, which is nearly 40.  For Thursday alone, there were seven bomb threats. | via Tara Yap 

📷: Mayor Jeffrey Silveo
